description: Tampered-signature golden vector for cross-language conformance (negative case). This is the same (payload, verifying_key) as sign-ed25519-conformance-001.json, but one byte of the signature has been flipped (the first hex char changed from 'e' to 'f', which flips bit 0 of the first signature byte). Every language verifier MUST reject this signature (expected=invalid). This locks the negative path of the conformance suite: a verifier that accepts a tampered signature is a critical security regression.
tamper: first signature byte 0xea -> 0xfa (bit 0 of the high nibble flipped)
notes: Derived from sign-ed25519-conformance-001.json. The conformance runner treats expected=invalid as a pass only when the verifier rejects the signature; a verifier that accepts it fails the suite.
